Proposed agenda (45–60 min):
- Quick recap of requirements (5 min)
- Network & data flow (10–15 min)
- Serving topology and KV cache expectations (10 min)
- Security/compliance callouts (5–10 min)
- Action items & timeline (10 min)

Two windows that work for our engineers (PT):
- Option A: Fri Oct 1 — 09:00–10:00 PT
- Option B: Fri Oct 1 — 10:30–11:30 PT

Attendees from our side: me (Pre-sales Mgr), Ben Carter (Infrastructure lead), Naomi Feldman (Solutions Engineer). Please let me know if you’d like additional folks on our side. If you can confirm attendees and the preferred slot, I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the draft agenda + runbook stub.

Attachments: redwood-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (draft), environment-runbook-vectra.pdf (stub)

Thanks,

- KV cache: would appreciate a short demo of TTL behavior and how cache warming is handled for prefix-heavy workloads
